entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need to start a return for an order I placed a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Could I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Sam Jones, and the order number is VF-789012.
Thanks, Sam. I'm pulling that up now... Okay, I see the Pro-Level Racing Jersey. What specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference, I guess. I ordered it, but it's the wrong size. It's just a little too tight for a comfortable ride. I was hoping to do an exchange for a large.

I understand completely. Let me just check the delivery date here... It looks like this jersey was delivered to you 51 days ago. Our policy allows for returns on standard apparel items within 90 days, so you're well within the timeframe. I can absolutely approve this return for you.

That's great news. I appreciate that. Since I'll be placing a new order for the correct size, and I have to go through the process of shipping this one back, is there any way you could offer a small discount code for the inconvenience?

I'm glad I could get that return approved for you, Sam. I understand the ask, but for a standard sizing exchange, my system doesn't allow me to generate promotional codes. However, I can issue your return shipping label right now and you'll get a full refund to your original payment method once we receive the item.
Alright, I understand. A full refund is fair enough. Thanks for checking for me. Please go ahead and send that label.
You're welcome. The return label is on its way to your email now. Once you re-order, standard shipping is typically 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Nope, that's all. Thanks for your help, Alex.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
